# Lab 19.1: Metadata Curation Tour

## What We Are Going to Do
Open the Metadata curation page, see how your BigQuery assets appear in Knowledge Catalog (formerly Dataplex Universal Catalog), and read an entry's metadata.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Enable the APIs and create a dataset for the module.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable dataplex.googleapis.com datalineage.googleapis.com
bq --location=US mk --dataset --description "Curated sales data" $PROJECT_ID:lab19
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
CREATE TABLE lab19.orders AS SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Open Metadata curation.** **Governance → Metadata curation**. Look at the sections for metadata generation, glossaries, aspects and data products.

3. **[Console] Open the catalog entry.** Search for `lab19.orders` in the Knowledge Catalog search. Open the entry and look at:
   - **Technical metadata**: schema, size, location (filled in automatically)
   - **Business metadata**: description, glossary terms, aspects (you add these)
   - **Runtime metadata**: data profile, quality score, lineage

4. **[CLI] List entry groups.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud dataplex entry-groups list --location=us --project=$PROJECT_ID
gcloud dataplex entry-groups list --location=global --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   BigQuery assets live in a system entry group (`@bigquery`), created automatically.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Ingestion | BigQuery assets catalogued automatically |
| Name | Knowledge Catalog (APIs still say `dataplex`) |
| Metadata types | Technical, business, runtime |
| Entry group | `@bigquery` system group |
